slate.title: The traitor runs for the door

excerpts.title: They Know the Intruder
excerpts.hook: An ear-splitting explosion destroys the cathedral entrance as armed figures emerge through the smoke.
excerpts.sinker_question: Who is the stranger powerful enough to command the royal guards' loyalty?
sinker_answers: The rightful Duke believed to be dead
A royal heir traveling under another identity
An agent carrying secret authority from the Crown

lines.label: SOUND FX
lines.text: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.

lines.label: ACTION
lines.text: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.

lines.label: ACTION
lines.text: Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.

lines.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling)
lines.text: "Who are you?"

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant)
lines.text: "You already know."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

lines.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper)
lines.text: "Alexander..."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring)
lines.text: "Juliana."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

lines.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical)
lines.text: "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

lines.label: ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant)
lines.text: "We will not."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

lines.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged)
lines.text: "I said arrest him!"

lines.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged)
lines.text: "Why?!"

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

lines.label: ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent)
lines.text: "Because we know who he is."

excerpts.title: She Is to Be Executed
excerpts.hook: A devastated mother tells her son that his wife is to be executed.
excerpts.sinker_question: What will the dead Duke do when he reaches the wedding before his wife's execution?
sinker_answers: Arrive after the sentence is carried out

lines.label: ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Gasping)
lines.text: "No."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

lines.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Solemn, Shattered)
lines.text: "She is to be executed."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Guttural, Demanding)
lines.text: "When?"

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

lines.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
lines.text: "After the wedding."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing)
lines.text: "What wedding?"

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

lines.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim)
lines.text: "Rupert... and Catherine's."

lines.label: SOUND FX
lines.text: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

lines.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Deadly Serious)
lines.text: "Two days from now."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Simmering with Fury)
lines.text: "They are marrying in two days..."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty)
lines.text: "...and killing my wife afterward."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.

lines.label: ACTION
lines.text: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling)
lines.text: "Two days."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance)
lines.text: "Then they have two days to celebrate."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise)
lines.text: "Because before that wedding begins..."

lines.label: CAMERA
lines.text: Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

lines.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale)
lines.text: "...their dead Duke is coming home."
